content:
{
  "project": "agentic-knowledge-mapper",
  "what_building": "A risk assessment service that evaluates the safety and robustness of multi-agent debate systems and other LLM-based architectures. It generates structured risk registers by mapping potential failure modes, such as sycophancy and prompt injection, to specific exposure tiers and control measures.",
  "pipeline": [
    "make_brief",
    "score_product_risk",
    "score_model_risk",
    "map_attacks",
    "emit_register"
  ],
  "inputs": [
    "brief",
    "product",
    "model_desc",
    "exposure_tier",
    "subject_profile"
  ],
  "outputs": [
    "risk_register",
    "exposure_tier_score",
    "control_recommendations",
    "attack_mapping"
  ],
  "confidence": 0.85,
  "evidence_quotes": [
    "heuristic guess: multi-agent debate risk scorer :: brief/product/model descriptors -> risk-scoring prompts (tiers 0-100, CVE/attack mapping) -> risk register",
    "Title: Risks and failure modes of multi-agent debate systems",
    "Exposure tier: confidential_data",
    "Control catalogue: - C01 Classification gate before AI (efficacy 0.7)"
  ]
}
